vo.en: You physically cannot lift this finger.

visual.description: A close-up shot of a man's hand with fingers spread, pointing directly at the camera.

vo.en: Fold your hands together like a prayer, then tuck your middle fingers inside so your knuckles touch.

visual.description: Two hands coming together and folding the middle fingers down into the palms.

vo.en: Now, try lifting your thumbs. Easy. Your index fingers? No problem. They have independent tendons.

visual.description: Close up of a person's thumbs and index fingers moving freely while the middle fingers stay folded.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Keep those middle fingers locked and try to lift your ring fingers.

visual.description: A man's hand visibly straining to move the ring finger while other fingers stay pressed.

vo.en: See? Your brain is screaming, but they won't budge. They are literally paralyzed by your own anatomy.

visual.description: Abstract visualization of glowing blue neural pathways and electric signals firing rapidly.

vo.en: This happens because your ring finger and middle finger share the exact same extensor tendon.

visual.description: An anatomical 3D render of a human hand showing the tendons and bones moving.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment GLITCH if you’re stuck—which is exactly why...

visual.description: A person's thumb clicking the subscribe button on a modern smartphone screen.
